sources.title: Covering relations for multidimensional dynamical systems
sources.reviewed: Appendix 6.1, multiplication property (102) and regular-value Corollary 21; earlier packet reviewed covering Theorems 9 and 16.
sources.comparison: Standard local-degree properties justify the neighborhood-conjugacy obstruction. No new general degree theorem is claimed.

sources.authors: S. V. Gonchenko, I. I. Ovsyannikov, C. Simo and D. Turaev
sources.title: Three-dimensional Henon-like maps and wild Lorenz-like attractors
sources.reviewed: Abstract, Introduction including equation (1), discussion around Figures 1-2. Figures 1-2 visually inspected on printed pages 3495-3496.
sources.comparison: The displayed quadratic map has constant determinant B. The certified negative even-period return excludes neighborhood conjugacy for B nonzero; it does not rule out visual similarity.

sources.authors: Alexander S. Gonchenko and Sergey V. Gonchenko
sources.title: Variety of strange pseudohyperbolic attractors in three-dimensional generalized Henon maps
sources.reviewed: Abstract, equation (1.4), relevant portions of Sections 3-5 concerning generalized maps, double/super figure-eight and quasiattractors. Figure 4 schematic and Figures 7-8 visually inspected on PDF pages 15, 19, 20.
sources.comparison: Known multi-lobed geometries and a nonsingular constant-determinant map family. No numerical reproduction or global shape identification was performed.

sources.authors: Isaac A. Garcia, Ernest Latorre and Susanna Maza
sources.title: On Periodic Orbits of Vector Fields in Arbitrary Dimension Via Autonomous and Nonautonomous Inverse Jacobi Multipliers
sources.reviewed: Abstract; Sections 2.1-2.2 on transverse monodromy, the tangent multiplier, and Liouville formula (17).
sources.comparison: Standard positivity of periodic flow and transverse-return determinants. No new flow theorem is claimed.

sources.title: A New 3D Four-Wing Chaotic System with Cubic Nonlinearity and Its Circuit Implementation
sources.reviewed: Publisher abstract only. No equations or figures inspected.
sources.comparison: Explicit prior four-wing smooth autonomous flow. Abstract-level evidence suffices to reject novelty of the wing-count label.

sources.authors: Quanli Deng, Chunhua Wang and Linmao Yang
sources.title: Four-Wing Hidden Attractors with One Stable Equilibrium Point
sources.reviewed: Abstract, Section 2 equation (1), Section 3.1. Figure 1 stability diagram and Figure 2 planar portraits visually inspected on printed pages 4-5.
sources.comparison: Four-dimensional polynomial flow; four-wing geometry and coexistence with a stable equilibrium are prior art. Its four planar projections do not establish equality with our full three-state cloud. No hidden-attractor classification is transferred.
sources.access: Web PDF extraction timed out; direct author-hosted download succeeded and was inspected locally.

sources.authors: Maxim Kodryan, Ekaterina Lobacheva, Maksim Nakhodnov and Dmitry Vetrov
sources.title: Training Scale-Invariant Neural Networks on the Sphere Can Happen in Three Regimes
sources.reviewed: Abstract and Sections 1-3.1, including projected-gradient update (2). No figures visually inspected.
sources.comparison: Sustained irregular training on a fixed sphere is established. This update differs from normalizing an internal reflected posterior vector; that formula difference alone is not an equivalence proof.
sources.access: ArXiv PDF exceeded web-tool content size; NeurIPS 2022 OpenReview copy was readable.
